title: Bench - tasks (SQL)
description: SQL on the tasks table over the selected range: throughput, lifecycle phases, statuses, dependencies. Runs only when displayed (load on the database).

list.name: partition
list.label: Partition
list.query: SELECT partition_id FROM partitions ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Completed tasks per second (10 s buckets)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(end_date, '10s', 0), options_partition_id AS metric, count(*) / 10.0 AS value FROM tasks WHERE status = 4 AND $__timeFilter(end_date) AND creation_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '$lookback' AND $__timeTo()::timestamp AND options_partition_id IN ($partition) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Created tasks per second (10 s buckets)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(creation_date, '10s', 0), options_partition_id AS metric, count(*) / 10.0 AS value FROM tasks WHERE $__timeFilter(creation_date) AND options_partition_id IN ($partition) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(end_date, '30s'), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from submitted_date - creation_date) * 1000) AS "submission", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from reception_date - submitted_date) * 1000) AS "queue wait", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from acquisition_date - reception_date) * 1000) AS "acquisition", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from fetched_date - acquisition_date) * 1000) AS "data fetch", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from start_date - fetched_date) * 1000) AS "wait for worker", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from end_date - start_date) * 1000) AS "execution" FROM tasks WHERE status = 4 AND $__timeFilter(end_date) AND creation_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '$lookback' AND $__timeTo()::timestamp AND options_partition_id IN ($partition) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(end_date, '30s'), percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from submitted_date - creation_date) * 1000) AS "submission", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from reception_date - submitted_date) * 1000) AS "queue wait", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from acquisition_date - reception_date) * 1000) AS "acquisition", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from fetched_date - acquisition_date) * 1000) AS "data fetch", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from start_date - fetched_date) * 1000) AS "wait for worker", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from end_date - start_date) * 1000) AS "execution" FROM tasks WHERE status = 4 AND $__timeFilter(end_date) AND creation_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '$lookback' AND $__timeTo()::timestamp AND options_partition_id IN ($partition) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: End to end: creation to end (ms, 30 s buckets)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(end_date, '30s'), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from end_date - creation_date) * 1000) AS median, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from end_date - creation_date) * 1000) AS p95, max(extract(epoch from end_date - creation_date) * 1000) AS max FROM tasks WHERE status = 4 AND $__timeFilter(end_date) AND creation_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '$lookback' AND $__timeTo()::timestamp AND options_partition_id IN ($partition) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT session_id, options_partition_id AS partition, min(creation_date) AS first_created, max(end_date) AS last_end, count(*) AS tasks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 4) AS completed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN (5, 6)) AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cardinality(retry_of_ids) > 0) AS retries, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cardinality(data_dependencies) > 1) AS with_dependencies, round(avg(extract(epoch from end_date - start_date) * 1000)::numeric) AS exec_ms_mean, round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from end_date - start_date) * 1000))::numeric) AS exec_ms_p95, round((count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 4) / nullif(extract(epoch from max(end_date) - min(start_date)), 0))::numeric, 1) AS tasks_per_s FROM tasks WHERE $__timeFilter(creation_date) AND options_partition_id IN ($partition) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3

SELECT CASE status WHEN 0 THEN 'Unspecified' WHEN 1 THEN 'Creating' WHEN 2 THEN 'Submitted' WHEN 3 THEN 'Dispatched' WHEN 4 THEN 'Completed' WHEN 5 THEN 'Error' WHEN 6 THEN 'Timeout' WHEN 7 THEN 'Cancelling' WHEN 8 THEN 'Cancelled' WHEN 9 THEN 'Processing' WHEN 10 THEN 'Processed' WHEN 11 THEN 'Retried' WHEN 12 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 13 THEN 'Paused' ELSE status::text END AS status, count(*) AS tasks FROM tasks WHERE $__timeFilter(creation_date) AND options_partition_id IN ($partition) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Data dependencies per task (created in range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT cardinality(data_dependencies)::text AS dependencies, count(*) AS tasks FROM tasks WHERE $__timeFilter(creation_date) AND options_partition_id IN ($partition) GROUP BY cardinality(data_dependencies) ORDER BY cardinality(data_dependencies)
